requirements.desc: A draft-questions raw ADVISORY containing only repairTargets shall be recorded once as canonical advisory findings with category=repair_target, and result_recording shall succeed.
requirements.note: R1: draft-questions repairTargets-only records one canonical advisory finding

requirements.desc: A draft-coverage raw ADVISORY containing only repairTargets shall use the same canonical advisory normalization and record successfully.
requirements.note: R2: draft-coverage repairTargets-only uses the same canonical advisory contract

requirements.desc: When advisoryFindings and repairTargets coexist, canonical recording shall preserve both as advisory findings and shall produce no blocking finding.
requirements.note: R3: advisory and repair findings remain advisory without a blocking record

requirements.desc: Every normalized repair target shall retain category=repair_target and its title, target, rationale, and evidence through canonical recording and triage handoff.
requirements.note: R4: repair target category and authored fields remain available to triage

requirements.desc: When blockingFindings, advisoryFindings, and repairTargets are all empty, the producer shall record PASS with zero canonical findings.
requirements.note: R5: empty draft review records PASS with zero canonical findings

requirements.desc: Canonical validation shall continue to reject ADVISORY with a blocking finding, PASS with any finding, and REJECTED without a blocking finding.
requirements.note: R6: repaired advisory baseline keeps invalid disposition matrices rejected

requirements.desc: The change shall not permit registration of the same artifact twice or rerunning review for the same phase, tree, and evidence.
requirements.note: R7: repaired advisory evidence records once and rejects duplicate or completed-target reuse

requirements.desc: A raw fixture with disposition=ADVISORY, blockingFindings=[], advisoryFindings=[], and repairTargets=[{title:"Empty initial QA list", target:"qa[]", rationale:"Initial QA list is empty before answer collection", evidence:"qa[] is empty before any answer exists"}] shall reproduce the current severity=blocking recording failure, then after the fix pass exactly once through producer normalization as severity=non-blocking and category=repair_target and advance to triage without invoking review AI.
requirements.note: R8: checkpoint-shaped repair target is recorded once without review AI
